summary.intent: Use the GSD manager dashboard to work through remaining v2.0 milestone phases (69-79) — verify/close out in-flight phases, discuss and plan unblocked phases in parallel worktrees, then execute them, and finally ship Phase 74 through the full post-execution gate pipeline (verify/secure/validate/simplify/SDK-E2E/CodeRabbit/PR).
summary.outcome: Closed out Phase 70.1 (SC#6 live crash-resume tests passed after fixing a stale API + missing env secret) and fixed a false 'Executing' status on Phase 69 (plan-scanner substring bug counting a RESEARCH.md as a PLAN file); planned and executed Phases 74, 75, and 77 across a multi-hour, quota-interrupted autonomous run using scheduled cron resumes; shipped Phase 74 via /ship-phase, catching a real base64/hex encoding defect in SC#2 grant re-mint (only surfaced by the Windows desktop-e2e integration leg) plus a dirty-resume revocation-bypass gap, both routed into a TDD gap-closure fix agent still in progress; captured a high-severity hardening todo to eliminate the recurring hex/base64 wire-encoding class of bugs via boundary codecs and branded types.

repo: GSD plan-file scanner (plan-scan.cjs:28) has a loose /PLAN/i substring fallback that miscounts any .md file containing 'PLAN' (e.g. 69-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md, 'write-PLANE') as a phase plan, inflating plan_count and flipping disk_status to 'partial'
GSD manager's is_active flag just means 'a file in the phase dir was modified in the last 5 minutes' — not that an agent is actually running

EnterWorktree refuses to pin a sub-agent launched at the repo root into a pre-existing worktree ('repo root, not an isolated worktree') — background planning agents that try this fail with zero mutations

GSD's commit helper sometimes false-negatives commit_failed / times out on slow pre-commit hooks (lint-staged ~1-2 min) even though the commit actually landed — verify via git log, never blindly retry
commit.gpgsign=false in this repo means autonomous commits don't block on 1Password biometric prompts
vitest does not load .env files — SDK_E2E_SECRET must be explicitly exported into the shell before running sdk-e2e, or the harness falls back to a default secret and gets 401

The cipher-box share API wire contract (create-share/create-invite/claim-invite/update-grant DTOs) validates encryptedReadKey/encryptedWriteKey as hex via @Matches(/^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/), while internal node-codec/sealed-ref fields (readKeySealed, persist_wrapped_key) use base64 — same Uint8Array type, opposite required encodings, nothing enforces the right choice at a call site

Phase 74's FuseRotationDeps.update_grant base64-encoded encrypted_read_key instead of hex, causing live re-mint to 400 — invisible to unit tests (mocked API) and only caught by the Windows desktop-e2e leg

GSD gsd-tools query phase uat-passed --require-verification treats 'implementation complete + verification passed but no UAT.md' as not-fully-done and downgrades disk_status to partial, even for CI/cargo-verified Rust/FUSE phases that never produce a human UAT file

CodeRabbit CLI (local, pre-PR) surfaces far fewer findings than CodeRabbit's GitHub PR-level review — the web review caught 12 unresolved threads including a Greptile P1-security finding that the CLI missed entirely
desktop-e2e is dispatch-gated (workflow_dispatch) on this repo, not automatically triggered by opening a PR

code.finding: re_mint_grants_rooted_at base64_encodes the wrapped read key for the update_grant wire call, but the API's UpdateGrantRequest DTO validates encryptedReadKey as hex — causes live rotation re-mint to fail with 400, only caught by desktop-e2e, not unit tests
SentShareResponse doc comments mislabeled encrypted_read_key/encrypted_write_key as 'Hex-encoded' when they are actually base64 (item_name_encrypted at line 192 is correctly hex)

TS rotatedNodes map stores the same Uint8Array reference used for parentNewReadKey (not a defensive copy like Rust's .clone()) — currently safe because no zeroization path touches parentNewReadKey, but a future change zeroing it would silently corrupt the returned key map
listPhasePlanFiles/scanPhasePlans loose fallback matches any .md filename containing the substring 'PLAN' (case-insensitive) as a plan file, causing false positives like *-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md

workflow: When a background agent dies mid-task from a session/quota limit, its worktree/branch state often survives further than the task-notification summary suggests (research/patterns committed even if the notification says 'just spawning the planner') — always assess actual disk/git state before re-dispatching rather than trusting the notification text

Sequential-on-main-checkout (switching branches, no parallel worktrees) is more robust than worktree-per-agent for GSD phase planning+execution, since sub-agents cannot EnterWorktree from repo root and worktrees also break commands requiring the installed workspace (pnpm/cargo)

Use CronCreate one-shot resumes with detailed 'what was in flight + working method + hard rules' prompts to survive quota-window cutoffs during long autonomous multi-phase runs; update/replace the cron each time the recovery strategy changes so a stale cron doesn't repeat a known-failing approach

Delegate build-heavy or stack-exclusive gate steps (SDK-E2E, security/crypto audits) to sub-agents with exclusive access to the shared docker stack/API rather than running them concurrently with other planners, to avoid RAM/DB contention

A CI integration leg (desktop-e2e / real client-API round trip) can surface encoding/wire-contract bugs that unit tests (mocked API) and even local CodeRabbit/security review completely miss — don't treat 'all local gates green' as done for wire-protocol-touching phases without running the real round trip

friction: Hit Claude session/quota limits three separate times mid-autonomous-run, killing background planner/executor agents (Phase 74, 75, 77 planners all died at least once)

Background planning agents using EnterWorktree into pre-existing worktrees failed outright (repo-root restriction), producing zero mutations and requiring a pivot to sequential main-checkout processing
A Phase 75 sub-agent's self-made background-wait loop stalled for ~21 minutes doing nothing productive, requiring a relaunch with explicit 'no background-waiting' instruction
GSD's commit helper reported commit_failed multiple times for commits that had actually landed, requiring manual git log verification each time
Desktop E2E Windows leg failed on real code (base64/hex bug), a genuine SC#2 regression that slipped through all local gates and unit tests
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL incompatibility, requiring gh api -X PATCH workarounds for PR body edits
Root-repo SECURITY.md file has a recurring bug where the security auditor writes to it instead of the phase-specific doc, requiring explicit instruction + verification to avoid
